profile.description: players row; null when no Player Profile exists.

scores.description: score_entries rows - every accepted Score Entry; classroom_id is null for Personal Play and a Clerk Organization id for Class Play.

access.description: player_access row; null before any signed-in Run.

lifetime_purchases.description: lifetime_purchases rows. Stripe identifiers only; no card data is ever stored.

classroom_memberships.description: classroom_memberships rows for every Classroom the Explorer belongs to.

quest_progress.description: Personal Play cloud_quest_progress row; null when Quest Continuity never synced.

journal.description: Personal Play learning_journals row - the privacy-minimized Lantern Journal outcomes.

class_quest_progress.description: Class Play cloud_quest_progress rows, each identified by classroom_id.

class_journals.description: Class Play learning_journals rows, each identified by classroom_id.

class_run_grants.description: Classroom Run Grants issued to this Explorer for assigned Class Expeditions: Labyrinth, Run identifier, and outcome status.

class_expedition_seats.description: Non-recyclable Class Expedition seats assigned to this Explorer.

class_expedition_licenses.description: Class Expedition Licenses and extensions this Explorer sponsored (Stripe identifiers only, never card data).

access_settings.description: explorer_access_settings row - presentation-only accessibility preferences; null before signed-in synchronization.

verified_daily_results.description: Server-replayed Daily result submissions and their stable response classification. Client idempotency tokens are excluded.

verified_daily_best_results.description: Current best replay-verified Daily result for each date, including its achievement time.

role.description: user_roles row; absence of a row means player.
